FLUTE.definition: A high-pitched woodwind instrument; a slender tube closed at one end with finger holes on one end and an opening near the closed end across which the breath is blown.

LEFT.gloss: location near or direction toward the left side
LEFT.definition: Location near or direction toward the left side; i.e. the side to the north when a person or object faces east.

FELT.gloss: a fabric made of compressed matted animal fibers
FELT.definition: A fabric made of compressed matted animal fibers.

FUEL.gloss: a substance that can be consumed to produce energy
FUEL.definition: A substance that can be consumed to produce energy.
FUEL.example: More fuel is needed during the winter months.

TUNE.gloss: a succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence
TUNE.definition: A succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence.
TUNE.example: She was humming an air from Beethoven.

LET.gloss: make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
LET.definition: Make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen.
LET.example: This permits the water to rush in.

FUN.gloss: activities that are enjoyable or amusing
FUN.definition: Activities that are enjoyable or amusing.
FUN.example: I do it for the fun of it.

TEN.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one
TEN.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system.

NET.gloss: a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the…
NET.definition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange.

FLU.gloss: an acute febrile highly contagious viral disease
FLU.definition: An acute febrile highly contagious viral disease.
